justification: Changes the rule text served on four more live routes (DCP browse page, rule-card cross-reference previews, quick-search clause lookup, provisions/by-ids) and moves the property page onto the shared helper. Wrong, a page would show words that are not the council's under a note saying they are.

pre_impl.existing_data: regulatory_provisions.council_quote, quote_page, quote_status (migration 111); clause route joins the live row onto regulatory_provisions_canonical by id
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A canonical-view text that differs from the live row: the clause route shows the live row's council words for that id, and the extracted canonical text with its note otherwise
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Applies on read to every row; nothing is written
pre_impl.external_source_error: No external source; the quote columns come from the same query. A DB error fails each route as before.
pre_impl.frontend_type: ProvisionDisplay Provision gains optional quoteNote; browse/section Provision gains quoteNote; clause and by-ids responses gain quote_status and quote_note
pre_impl.user_failure_mode: If the swap failed the page shows the extracted text as before, with the note saying it is not matched or not yet checked -- visible, not silent

functions.name: withCouncilWords
functions.input: one database row carrying provision_text, council_quote, quote_page and quote_status columns
functions.output: the row as served: council words in, quote removed, status normalised
functions.if_none: missing quote columns read undefined and the extracted text is kept with its note

values.if_missing: extracted text with 'Not yet checked against the council's PDF'

queries.purpose: browse a DCP section's rules with their quote columns
queries.where_clause: p.document_id = $1 AND p.is_current = TRUE AND p.pdf_page in the section's range (unchanged)
queries.if_wrong: each quote travels in its own row, so a rule cannot show another rule's words

break_it.scenario: A route keeps serving the reader's words while the property page serves the council's
break_it.what_happens: the same rule reads differently on two pages of the site
break_it.how: all five live routes call lib/council-quote.ts withCouncilWords

break_it.scenario: The clause route spreads the raw row and sends council_quote twice
break_it.what_happens: the payload carries the quote twice and a client could show the wrong field
break_it.how: clause route destructures council_quote out before building the response

break_it.scenario: The browse page links the stored page while showing words copied from another page
break_it.what_happens: the page link opens a page that does not hold the words shown
break_it.how: browse/section sends quote_page as pdfPage when the words are the council's

break_it.scenario: The browse query returns rows from the wrong document or section
break_it.what_happens: a section shows rules that are not printed in it
break_it.how: WHERE clause unchanged; quote columns are only added to the select list

break_it.scenario: An unconfirmed council rule shown on the browse page carries no note
break_it.what_happens: a reader would take the extracted text for the council's own wording
break_it.how: browse/section sends quoteNote(row) and ProvisionDisplay prints it under every council rule
break_it.repro: npx jest __tests__/lib/council-quote.test.ts -t 'says what the check found'

falsifiable_check.fails_when: withCouncilWords sends the quote twice, keeps the reader's words for a confirmed rule, or a confirmed rule links a page other than its quote page
falsifiable_check.observed_red: Before this change browse/section, cross-references, clause and by-ids returned provision_text unchanged; the 'serves a row once' test fails if withCouncilWords leaves council_quote in the row.
falsifiable_check.external_authority: Preview of #1277 on 2026-10-12: for-property returned 6,948 rules, 3,986 exact and 382 recovered served as the council's words, council_quote sent 0 times.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes: on the preview, open a DCP section in /dcp-browse and check the note under each rule
